name: the own-account profile page

regions_read.verdict_on_region: the account's own display name, printed as the largest text on the page; it names a person, not a part of the app, and nothing says this is a profile — dismissed as content
Main / Wishlist tabs inside the profile, 'Main' underlined; names a sub-tab, not a part of the app — not counted
floating pill of shortcuts (Quests / Shop / Nitro / Settings); no item is declared or drawn as current (confirmed live) — not a location signal

identifier_found: none that names the page; the largest text is the account's display name 'Accessibility Testing', the tabs say 'Main' / 'Wishlist', and the bottom pill has no current item
accessibility_text: no content_description or label names the page as a profile; the only related strings are the 'Edit Profile' button and the 'Amp up your profile' card, both drawn on screen as body copy
initial_rationale: the only large text is a person's name, not a place; no title, no active nav state; 'Edit Profile' hints at the page but is a button, not a title

test_cases.precondition: app open on the own-account profile page (reached from the account chip at the bottom of the panel)
test_cases.action: scroll the page up past the display name and back down; look for a collapsing title or any word naming the page
test_cases.expected_result: either a title such as 'Profile' or 'You' appears in some scroll state, or none exists
test_cases.confirms_if: no title appears in any scroll state; the only large text is the display name
test_cases.overturns_if: a title naming the page appears on scroll
test_cases.observed_result: no title in any scroll state; scrolling up carried the close X, the avatar and the display name 'Accessibility Testing' up the screen with the content and nothing was pinned in their place. Words on the page: 'Edit Profile', 'Main', 'Wishlist', 'Orbs Balance', 'Member Since', 'Friends', 'Note (only visible to you)'

test_cases.action: inspect the floating pill (Quests / Shop / Nitro / Settings) for a current-item highlight
test_cases.expected_result: one pill item is drawn as current, which would place the user
test_cases.confirms_if: no pill item is drawn or declared as current
test_cases.overturns_if: a pill item is visibly highlighted as the current section
test_cases.observed_result: all four items drawn identically in black glyph + label; none declared selected; the pill is shortcuts, not a location

deciding_evidence: confirmed live: no title in any scroll state, and no pill item is current. The 'Edit Profile' button is the nearest thing to a name and is body copy on a control, not a title; strictly, nothing tells a first-time user which part of the app this is. No evaluated transition lands here (touch edges t7 / t8 are not evaluated in this phase).
recommendation: add a visible page title such as 'Your Profile' (or 'You') in the top bar beside the close X, pinned while the page scrolls
